findings.finding: Original actual-looking institution identities and opening hours were unverified. All eight locations now have explicit generic fictional names and descriptions; opening hours and addresses are null. Scene displays, notice contents, product conditions and routes are hypothetical.
Corrected unsupported role pairing Park/Community Staff to existing Park/Park Staff; no category or asset was added.

Station staff does not predict actual departure or arrival. Government staff collects a consultation and language-support request without booking or determining obligations. Nurse separates receipt from employer evidence requirements and refers issuance questions. Police records uncertain loss information without finding or ownership guarantees. Postal staff organizes enquiries without fixing pickup conditions. Bank staff refers a found-card update without claiming suspension, cancellation, restoration or reissue complete.
